title: CommonEnums
description: Shared enums and small helpers used across other schemas.

SystemName.description: Target execution system for a Script/ScriptAction.

RunStatus.description: Status reported by ScriptEngine for a running or finished action/script. The first four are ScriptExecutionState values. The last three come from ScriptExecutionStatusDetail: script_executor.py calls script_logger.get_action_log().set_status(status_detail), which writes the detail into this same field, so a terminated run's node reports why it stopped rather than a bare FAILURE. Readers should treat every value except RUNNING and SUCCESS as a failure-like terminal state.

QueueStatus.description: Status used in Script-Engine-Controller queue files (running_scripts/completed_scripts).

FileType.description: Type of a ScriptActionLog artifact file.

FilePair.description: ScriptActionLog file reference pair (file_type + file_path). Empty object {} means no file is attached.
